players.product: 8-inch specialty foundry (PMIC / power discretes) with GaN-on-QST power platform; TSMC-licensed 650V/80V GaN-on-Si (development from early 2026, production targeted 1H 2028); VSMC 300mm JV fab in Singapore with NXP (production from 2027)

contracts.signal: VSMC, the joint venture of VIS and NXP established in September 2024, opened its first 12-inch (300mm) fab in Tampines, Singapore. With construction complete, the fab has entered risk production, with volume production scheduled to begin in the first quarter of 2027; after 22 months of construction its first sample lot achieved yields above 99%. It supports 130nm to 40nm process technologies for mixed-signal, power management, analog and interposer applications serving HPC, mobile, automotive, industrial and consumer end markets, and at full capacity by 2029 is expected to produce approximately 44,000 12-inch wafers per month. NXP CEO Rafael Sotomayor: 'Our planned manufacturing capacity at VSMC remains unchanged'; VSMC enhances NXP's 'geographic resilience, supply control, and cost competitiveness'.
